Answer: B
Reason: The pre-operative image (Figure 1a) shows a massive right-sided opacity causing significant leftward shift of the trachea and heart. The post-operative image (Figure 1c) demonstrates that while the mass has been removed and the mediastinal structures remain shifted to the left (likely due to chronic adaptation or residual volume loss), the right lung has re-expanded but not completely, showing some residual opacity and surgical clips.
